description: This file defines the DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor class, which implements monitoring for a queue adapter receiver in Orleans streaming. It includes counters and gauges for tracking initialization, read, and shutdown metrics, as well as message counts and enqueue ages.

classes.name: DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor
classes.description: A monitor class for tracking metrics related to a queue adapter receiver in Orleans streaming, including counters for failures, exceptions, message counts, and enqueue ages.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Tracks the initialization process, recording success/failure, call duration, and exceptions.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Tracks read operations, recording success/failure, call duration, and exceptions.

methods.name: TrackMessagesReceived
methods.description: Records the number of messages received and their enqueue times to update age gauges.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Tracks shutdown operations, recording success/failure, call duration, and exceptions.
